owner_priority_lock.rule: Follow the explicit owner direction to pause technical_refactor and prioritize tour-search UX and user-facing visual work on AnyTour Design System 2.0.

current_stage.name: Public-route DS2 hierarchy convergence after hot/contacts cleanup
current_stage.last_material_progress: PR #683 fixed two confirmed public-route DS2 hierarchy/wrapping defects. On /hot/, hotel-category stars are now grouped as one non-wrapping semantic label so a five-star marker cannot fragment across narrow card lines; on /contacts/, the two nested cards under the section-level heading now use h3 rather than duplicate h2, restoring the intended section/card hierarchy. All PR checks passed, including standalone five-width visual validation and search/selected-tour regression gates. Both Deploy V2 only and Deploy anytoour.ru completed successfully; V2 verification, public-page verification, unchanged lead-bridge validation and live-search smoke all passed. Search/Tourvisor, analytics/Metrika, logo, verified destinations, pricing and lead transport were unchanged.
current_stage.next_action: Continue the public-route DS2 hierarchy pass on /how-to-buy/ first, then /rb/. Recheck /hot/ and /contacts/ in post-deploy five-width evidence, then fix only confirmed hierarchy/spacing/wrapping/overflow/shared-shell defects. Preserve the mature search/results/selected-tour path and loaded-results instant-local-filtering architecture.

local_results_filtering.rule: Result filters such as stars/rating/price/meal and other fields already present in normalized loaded results filter the loaded set instantly. A new Tourvisor search is reserved for real search-input changes or optional background capability expansion, not for every result-filter click.

site_wide_score.note: Two real public-route hierarchy/wrapping defects were removed and production deploy passed, but the visible slice is still too narrow to claim a whole-product score increase.
